prompts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / compositing.
Asset: one finished Portuguese Instagram carousel slide, portrait 3:4, target 1086 x 1448 pixels.
The supplied photo is the EDIT TARGET and the ONLY photographic source. Use that actual photograph as a full-bleed background from edge to edge, visible in EVERY part of the canvas. Only crop/scale it and overlay typography and a gentle translucent navy gradient where text needs contrast. Preserve every face, identity, expression, body, pose, clothing, object, natural lighting, texture and original photographic imperfections. DO NOT redraw, beautify, restore or invent people, scenes or objects. No background replacement, illustration, artificial tech scenery, solid panels, opaque blocks, UI cards, robots, logos or fake code. The user wants authentic photos, not an AI-looking image.
Design: bold professional monospaced developer typography, JetBrains Mono-style; big catchy headline, well-spaced readable regular body. Electric cyan #00E5FF accents, warm white #F8FAFC. Straight cyan underlines immediately below specified important words, not through them. Left alignment, consistent 7% margins, ample breathing space. Navy gradients must remain translucent and reveal the photograph. Keep faces clear and uncovered. All text exact with correct Portuguese accents. Footer bottom-left "modelos de IA • software" in small white; bottom-right given page number. Tiny date "OUT / 2026" near top label. Render only the requested overlay copy, no other generated words. The real photo may contain existing board writing/signs, which must remain as photo details.
